$schema_note: Registry of captured design systems. Each entry = one folder. To add a source: create <id>/ with index.html + tokens.css + tokens.json + assets/, then append an entry here. The hub (index.html) renders this file.

sources.name: Squad Hub
sources.description: Our own design system. A monochrome editorial language — an ink scale over hairline borders, Instrument Serif display numerals, JetBrains Mono eyebrows, one blue accent with semantic color reserved for status. Three surfaces (Squad Hub / Web App / Admin), fully dark-mode aware. Icons harvested live from the web + admin source.

sources.name: ClickUp
sources.description: 2026 AI-era rebrand: monochrome canvas, four neon accents with pastel badge tints, gradient CTAs, Plus Jakarta Sans headlines with gradient text fills, full dark "Brain" theme.
